rationale: The current Premier aggregate row names Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+ with paired SOAR. The detailed 8.8 and 8.7 task guides require ES 8.7+ for their Cloud scope; the 8.8 guide separately lists Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0 for CMP, plus existing triaged findings and inherited connector/action/asset permissions. Editions and regions remain capability-specific. The current 8.8 notes document November 4 GA. The exact October Controlled Availability passage and the original Triage note were not recovered, leaving the registered historical scope incomplete. Exact SOAR pairs, individual rollout, entitlement and authorization are excluded.
